overview_description.description: Infisical is an open-source platform that focuses on the secure management of application secrets, certificates, SSH keys, and configurations. It provides tools for teams to effectively manage sensitive information across various applications and environments. The platform features end-to-end encryption, ensuring that data remains protected during storage and transmission. Infisical also offers a user-friendly interface that simplifies the process of injecting secrets like API keys and database credentials into applications. Centralizing configuration management enhances collaboration among development teams and streamlines workflows, making it easier to maintain security and efficiency in software development.

about_short_description.short_description: Infisical is an open-source secrets manager that secures and syncs app configs and credentials across teams with end-to-end encryption.

product.name: Secrets Management
product.description: A centralized platform for storing, syncing, rotating, and auditing application secrets and configuration across environments, workloads, teams, and infrastructure.

product.name: Certificate Management
product.description: A platform for managing private certificate authorities and automating certificate discovery, issuance, renewal, revocation, deployment, and auditing.

product.name: Privileged Access Management
product.description: A privileged access platform that provides short-lived, identity-based access to infrastructure and databases with session auditing, recording, and automatic credential rotation.

product.name: Agent Vault
product.description: A credential-brokering product that lets AI agents access approved tools and APIs without exposing the underlying secrets to the agents.

product.name: Infisical Radar
product.description: A secrets-scanning product that detects hardcoded credentials in source code and helps prevent them from being committed to version control systems.

product.name: Key Management
product.description: A key management capability for controlling cryptographic keys used to protect secrets and other sensitive data within Infisical deployments.
